findings.description: The bucket does not configure default server-side encryption, so encryption of uploaded objects is not enforced by this configuration.
The bucket does not configure default server-side encryption, so encryption of stored ledger exports is not enforced by this configuration.
Versioning and access logging do not enforce object encryption. No default server-side encryption configuration is present for model artifacts.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration, leaving encryption of uploaded runbook objects dependent on individual uploaders.
